# Intro

Create a COP Baseline using FIA data the USDA Bioregions around Quabbin.

# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(targets)
  library(tarchetypes)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(terra)
  library(tidyterra)
  library(sf)
  library(rnaturalearth)
  library(ggspatial)
  library(measurements)
})
tar_source()
```

Preload targets results

```{r, eval = FALSE}
tar_load(fiadb)
tar_load(species_crosswalk)
tar_load(fvs_num_partitions)
tar_load(fvs_partition)
tar_load(fvs_randseed)

tar_load(fvsne_states)

tar_load(nrsgro_plot)

get_this_rmd_file() |>
  tar_objects_defined_in_rmd() |>
  tar_load()
```

# Context

There are no FIA plots in the Northeast until the 1980s, and then
only a handful until the 2000s.

Let's see what we can do to build a baseline of harvest from
the FIA data.

## USFS Ecosubsections

FIA references USFS Ecosubsections, which similiar to but not the same
as EPA ecoregions. I'll work with USFS Ecosubsections, since this is
both defensible and easier.

## Quabbin Subsections

Quabbin Reservoir is in USFS Ecosubsection 221Ah. Following Finzi 2020
and extending the comparable range north, I will also look at USFS
Ecosubsections M211Bd and 221Ai in southern New Hampshire.

221Ai is the Gulf of Maine Coastal Plain; it has a distinct ecology
from the inland hills, plateaus and plains, so I will exclude it.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
usfs_ecosub <- terra::vect(file.path(
  "/vsizip",
  "data/raw/Ecosys_EcomapSubsections_2007.gdb.zip",
  "Ecosys_EcomapSubsections_2007.gdb"
)) |>
  # These come in EPSG:4269, which is a meters projection
  # for North America. Convert to lat/lon like everything else.
  # Note that EPSG:4269 is NAD83, whereas EPSG:4326 is WGS84,
  # so this re-projection is not meter accurate.
  terra::project(crs("epsg:4326"))
```

## FIA Plots

When did we get plots in each ecoregion of interest?
```{r, eval = FALSE}
fia_plots_filtered(fiadb, plots = NULL, filter = \(.data, con) {
  .data |>
    filter(ECOSUBCD %in% c("M211Bd", "221Ah")) |>
    group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT) |>
    filter(INVYR == min(INVYR, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(ECOSUBCD, INVYR) |>
    summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
}) |>
  group_by(ECOSUBCD) |>
  mutate(n = cumsum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(INVYR, n, color = ECOSUBCD)) +
  geom_step() +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1970, 2020), ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  ggtitle("Number of FIA plots in Ecosub M211Bd and 221Ah") +
  ylab("Number of Plots") +
  xlab("Year")
```

## Map

```{r, eval = FALSE}
fvsne_states_map <- fvsne_states |>
  distinct(STATE_NAME) |>
  rename(region = STATE_NAME) |>
  _$region |>
  map_data("state", region = _)

fvsne_ecosub_map <- usfs_ecosub |>
  filter(MAP_UNIT_SYMBOL %in% c("M211Bd", "221Ah"))

map_ext <- fvsne_ecosub_map |>
  terra::buffer(50 * 1000) |>
  terra::ext()

lakes_north_america <- ne_download(
  scale = 10, type = "lakes_north_america", category = "physical"
)
fvsne_bbox <- st_as_sfc(
  st_bbox(fvsne_ecosub_map |> terra::buffer(50*1000))
)
st_crs(fvsne_bbox) <- "WGS84"
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
lakes_ecosub <- lakes_north_america[
  st_intersects(lakes_north_america, fvsne_bbox, sparse = FALSE),
]

plot_location_tmp <- fia_plots_filtered(
  fiadb, plots = NULL, filter = \(.data, con) {
    .data |>
      filter(ECOSUBCD %in% c("M211Bd", "221Ah")) |>
      group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT) |>
      filter(INVYR == min(INVYR, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
      ungroup()
  }
) |>
  filter_add_stand_id() |>
  select(STAND_ID, CN, LAT, LON, ELEV, ECOSUBCD) |>
  rename(
    StandID = STAND_ID,
    group = CN,
    lat = LAT,
    long = LON,
    elev = ELEV
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_spatvector(
    data = fvsne_ecosub_map,
    mapping = aes(group = MAP_UNIT_SYMBOL, fill = MAP_UNIT_NAME),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = lakes_ecosub,
    fill = "blue",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = fvsne_states_map,
    mapping = aes(long, lat, group = group),
    fill = "transparent",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_location_tmp,
    mapping = aes(long, lat, group = group),

    color = "white"

    data = plot_location_tmp,

    color = "black"
  ) +

  coord_sf(
    crs = "epsg:4326",
    xlim = c(map_ext$xmin, map_ext$xmax),
    ylim = c(map_ext$ymin, map_ext$ymax)
  ) +
  annotation_scale(location = "br") +
  annotation_north_arrow(
```

How many?

```{r, eval = FALSE}
plot_location_tmp |>
  left_join(
    usfs_ecosub |> as.data.frame(), by = join_by(ECOSUBCD == MAP_UNIT_SYMBOL)
```

So a little over 500 plots by the end.

## Harvest

How many of these plots ever get harvested?

```{r, eval = FALSE}
get_harvested_plots <- function() {
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), fiadb, flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(con), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)

  plots_harvested_bycond <- tbl(con, "COND") |>
    group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT, INVYR) |>
    filter(
      sum(
        if_else(!is.na(TRTCD1) & TRTCD1 == 10, 1,
          if_else(!is.na(TRTCD2) & TRTCD2 == 10, 1,
            if_else(!is.na(TRTCD3) & TRTCD3 == 10, 1, 0)
          )
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) > 0
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    inner_join(
        tbl(con, "PLOT") |>
        filter(ECOSUBCD %in% c("M211Bd", "221Ah")),
        by = join_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT, INVYR)
    ) |>
    collect()
}
  
plot_harvested_tmp <- get_harvested_plots()
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
plot_harvested_tmp |>
  distinct(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT) |>
  nrow()
```

So, 52 plots were harvested

```{r, eval = FALSE}
plot_harvested_tmp |>
  distinct(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT, INVYR) |>
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT) |>
  filter(n() > 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  nrow()
```

12 are harvested more than once

```{r, eval = FALSE}
plot_harvested_tmp |>
  distinct(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT, CONDID) |>
  nrow()
```

71 conditions; unclear from this whether any plots have harvest on
a subset of their conditions, and whether unharvested conditions
are forested.

# Forest Type

What forest type do the harvested plots have?

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cond_harvested_tmp <- fia_conds(fiadb, plot_harvested_tmp)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cond_harvested_tmp |>
  ggplot(aes(FORTYPE)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -30, hjust = 0, vjust = 1))
```

That's a bunch of NA FORTYPEs; what up?

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cond_harvested_tmp |> filter(is.na(FORTYPE)) |> distinct(FORTYPCD, FLDTYPCD, ALSTKCD)
```

So we genuinely don't know what's on those conditions.

Do the other conditions on those plots have forest types?

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cond_harvested_tmp |>
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT) |>
  mutate(any_missing_fortype = any(is.na(FORTYPCD))) |>
  slice_max(if_else(is.na(FORTYPCD), 0, FORTYPCD)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(any_missing_fortype) |>
  distinct(FORTYPCD, FLDTYPCD, ALSTKCD)
```

So, other conditions on those plots do have forest type.
We can use those as a proxy. Let's aggregate by plot.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cond_harvested_tmp |>
  filter(!is.na(FORTYPCD)) |>
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT) |>
  slice_min(FORTYPCD) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(fct_infreq(FORTYPE))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "blue") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -30, hjust = 0, vjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle("FIA Plots Harvested near Quabbin") +
  xlab("Forest Type") +
  ylab("Number of Plots")
```

Other than eastern white pine, these look like opportune harvests.
They all fit the forest types seen in quabbin.
So I'll take the rate of harvest of all these forest types in FIA.

## FIA Forest Types

Should be able to plot those at the same time

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cficop_fia_plots |>
  anti_join(plot_harvested_tmp, by = join_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT)) |>
  fia_conds(fiadb, plots = _) |>
  mutate(
    STAND_ID = sprintf("%04d%03d%05d", STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT),
    harvested = "not harvested"
  ) |>
  select(STAND_ID, FORTYPCD, FORTYPE, harvested) |>
  union_all(
    cond_harvested_tmp |>
      mutate(
        STAND_ID = sprintf("%04d%03d%05d", STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT),
        harvested = "harvested"
      ) |>
      select(STAND_ID, FORTYPCD, FORTYPE, harvested)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(FORTYPCD)) |>
  group_by(STAND_ID) |>
  slice_min(FORTYPCD) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    harvested = ordered(harvested, levels = c("not harvested", "harvested"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(fct_infreq(FORTYPE), fill = harvested)) +
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -30, hjust = 0, vjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle("FIA Plots near Quabbin") +
  xlab("Forest Type") +
  ylab("Number of Plots") +
  labs(fill = NULL)
```

# Harvest Frequency & Intensity

## Frequency

How frequently is a plot harvested?

```{r, eval = FALSE}
plot_harvested_tmp |>
  mutate(
    STAND_ID = sprintf("%04d%03d%05d", STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT),
    HRVYR = case_when(
      !is.na(TRTCD1) & TRTCD1 == 10 ~ TRTYR1,
      !is.na(TRTCD2) & TRTCD2 == 10 ~ TRTYR2,
      !is.na(TRTCD3) & TRTCD3 == 10 ~ TRTYR3,
      .default = INVYR
    )
  ) |>
  distinct(STAND_ID, HRVYR) |>
  group_by(STAND_ID) |>
  arrange(HRVYR) |>
  mutate(harvest_interval = HRVYR - lag(HRVYR)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(harvest_interval)) |>
  ggplot(aes(harvest_interval)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "blue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("FIA Harvest Interval") +
  xlab("Years between Harvest") +
  ylab("Number of plots")
```

## Intensity

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cficop_fia_trees_tmp <- plot_harvested_tmp |>
  fia_trees(fiadb, plots = _)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
harvest_intensity <- cficop_fia_trees_tmp |>
  mutate(
    STAND_ID = sprintf("%04d%03d%05d", STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT),
    harvested = STATUSCD == 3,
    live = STATUSCD == 1 | PREV_STATUS_CD == 1,
    live = coalesce(live, harvested)
  ) |>
  filter(live | harvested) |>
  group_by(STAND_ID, INVYR) |>
  summarize(
    num_live = sum(if_else(live, 1, 0)),
    num_harvested = sum(if_else(harvested, 1, 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    harvest_intensity = num_harvested / (num_harvested + num_live)
  ) |>
  filter(harvest_intensity > 0)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
harvest_intensity |>
  ggplot(aes(harvest_intensity)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, fill = "blue") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("FIA Harvest Intensity") +
  ylab("Number of Plots") +
  xlab("Fraction of stems harvested")
```

## Conclusion

We'll harvest all forest types at 25% intensity every 20 years.

```{targets cficop_fia_thinata, tar_simple = TRUE}
cficop_fia_thinata <- cficop_dflt_treelist |>
  mutate(SpeciesFIA = as.integer(SpeciesFIA)) |>
  mutate(
    wood_type = case_when(
      SpeciesFIA == 125 | # Red Pine
        SpeciesFIA == 129 ~ # Eastern White Pine
        "Red/White Pine",
      SpeciesFIA == 833 | # Northern Red Oak
        SpeciesFIA == 318 | # Sugar Maple
        SpeciesFIA == 541 | # White Ash
        SpeciesFIA == 762 ~ # Black Cherry
        "High-Value Hardwood",
      .default = "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(wood_type == "Red/White Pine" | wood_type == "High-Value Hardwood") |>
  # We're only harvesting 14" and bigger
  filter(DBH >= 14) |>
  # This finds the year when EITHER the valuable softwood or hardwood
  # reaches 1500 bd ft / acre; it's probably valid to harvest when the
  # COMBINED bd ft / acred reaches 1500 bd ft / acre
  group_by(Year, StandID, wood_type) |>
  summarize(
    BoardFeet = sum(BdFt * TPA),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(BoardFeet > 1500 / 0.25) |>
  group_by(StandID) |>
  slice_min(Year) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(MasterPlotID = as.numeric(StandID)) |>
  select(MasterPlotID, HarvestYear = Year) |>
  # Harvest in the HarvestYear, and 20 years later
  mutate(
    HarvestPlus20 = HarvestYear + 20,
    HarvestPlus40 = HarvestYear + 40
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(!MasterPlotID, values_to = "HarvestYear") |>
  select(MasterPlotID, HarvestYear) |>
  filter(HarvestYear <= 2020) |>
  mutate(
    TARGET_TPA = 0,
    PERCENT = 0.25,
    DBH_MIN = 14, # MA Guidelines
    DBH_MAX = 999 # No upper bound
  ) |>
  # For ThinATA, our schema is:
  # STAND_CN, YEAR, TARGET_TPA, PERCENT, DBH_MIN, DBH_MAX
  # Not Implemented: HEIGHT_MIN, HEIGHT_MAX
  # Get STAND_CN
  left_join(
    cfigro_plot |>
      filter(INV_YEAR == 1970) |>
      select(STAND_CN, STAND_ID),
    by = join_by(MasterPlotID == STAND_ID)
  ) |>
  select(
    STAND_CN,
    YEAR = HarvestYear,
    TARGET_TPA,
    PERCENT,
    DBH_MIN,
    DBH_MAX
  ) |>
  # Arrange this for humans to be able to digest
  arrange(STAND_CN, YEAR)
```

# Run FVS

What happens with the baseline scenario as set up by the 1956 NERS
report?

```{targets cficop_fia}
tar_target(
  cficop_fia,
  {
    timestep <- 10 # years; determined by FVSne variant
    fvsbin_dir <- "~/bin" # TODO: put these in a config file
    fvs_variant <- "FVSne"      # TODO: put these in a config file
    data_dir <- "data/fvs"
    title <- "CFICOP"
    mgmt_id <- "BL56"
    project_dir <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("FVS_", title, "_", mgmt_id))
    if (!dir.exists(project_dir)) {
      dir.create(project_dir)
    }
    
    fvs_run(
      fvsbin_dir = fvsbin_dir,
      fvs_variant = fvs_variant,
      project_dir = project_dir,
      fiadb = NULL,
      title = title,
      mgmt_id = mgmt_id,
      stands = cfigro_plot |>
        # Filter out the 6 plots that do not get a sibling
        semi_join(
          cficop_plot_sibling,
          by = join_by(STAND_ID == MasterPlotID)
        ) |>
        mutate(
          ASPECT = if_else(SLOPE > 0 & ASPECT == 0, 360, ASPECT),
          # We don't use microplot data, but there are 4x6' radius
          # microplots
          INV_PLOT_SIZE = 385/4
        ),
      trees = cficop_dflt_trees,
      regen = cficop_dflt_estab,
      harvest = cficop_fia_thinata,
      num_partitions = fvs_num_partitions,
      partition = fvs_partition,
      random_seed = fvs_randseed
    )
  },
  # iteration = "vector" branches execution for each partition value (see below)
  iteration = "vector",
  # cross() and map() are unparsed targets:: functions here.
  # cross() ensures that every combination of values for its arguments is processed
  # map() distributes each value of its argument to a separate sub-target (branch)
  # so cross(randseed, map(partition)) will run each partition in a separate branch,
  # and each branch will run with each value of randseed
  pattern = cross(fvs_randseed, map(fvs_partition))
)
```


## Scenario Plots

I use this a lot; capture it as a thing:

```{r cficop_bl56_carbon_cmp, eval = FALSE}
cficop_fia_carbon_cmp <- cficop_fia_carbon |>
  mutate(name = "FIA Baseline", method = "Projected") |>
  union_all(
    cficop_bl56_carbon |>
      mutate(name = "1956 Baseline", method = "Projected")
  ) |>
  union_all(
    cficop_dflt_carbon |>
      mutate(name = "Grow-Only", method = "Projected")
  ) |>
  union_all(
    cficop_srvy_carbon |>
      mutate(name = "Actual", method = "Measured")
  ) |>
  union_all(
    cficop_hvst_carbon |>
      filter(Year %% 10 == 0) |>
      mutate(name = "Actual (Modeled)", method = "Projected")
  ) |>
  rename(
    value = Aboveground_Total_Live
  )

cficop_fia_carbon_cmp_summary <- cficop_fia_carbon_cmp |>
  group_by(Year, name, method) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymin = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.96 * sd(value) / sqrt(n),
    ymax = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.96 * sd(value) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### IFM vs Baseline

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cficop_fia_carbon_cmp_summary |>
#  filter(name %in% c("1956 Baseline", "Actual (Modeled)", "Actual")) |>
  ggplot(aes(Year, mean, color = name)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = method)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Projected" = "dashed", "Measured" = "solid"),
    guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(45, 150)) +
  labs(
    title = "Quabbin CFI Carbon Projection",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab(bquote("Aboveground Live Carbon" ~(`Mg C` %.% ha^-1)))
```
